title_short: Barbara (Haven resident) · Everybody Has a Story
headline: A Haven resident has to choose between food and medication, and wants people to know that everybody has a story.
story: Barbara has to have food, but she also has to have medication. Medication is more important, so she does without food.
People who have never been homeless don't understand: they're not all drug addicts. Many lost their homes to medical issues. Being homeless ages you; she turned gray.
Her message: take it day by day. Don't give up, because there is help out there.
